facts.fact: ILLIMI Niger says its platform, local AI assistant and analysis tools stay accessible to partner institutions after a 1-12 June 2026 training of 100 professionals from state bodies on using AI for data analysis and reports.
ILLIMI Niger says the platform serves partner institutions including HACP, the Interior ministry, INS and ANSI.

systems.platform: multisectoral data platform with local AI assistant and analysis tools
